book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Gas a migana ila sapsapong
Urie, Iesu la unum ga ula ga agimaong non migana ila sapsapong. Tara la iaria naga ang irie la sapsapong ara.

Ga lop am Iesu la amarikmeng Iesu, “Migana o usingnualap, aga la okosarong kirinim na tara la iaria naga iriro migana ga sapsapong? Iriro migana kan la okosarong kirinim, o mamo ga naga ang la okosarliong kirinim?”

Pa upulo Iesu ties gare ro, “Iriro migana la tale okosarong kirinim, ga ira ang ga naga ang gat la tale okosarliong kirinim. Karuk. Iriro paga la betong meba ogimameng teip ga magaulap ubi ang Morowa la betieng la uakap ira iriro migana.
Titot la man ileng ka tie okosarbuong ubi ang Morowa irie la tosagaong ga muruo. Leba betieng arubu, tale kan puoong migana ba leba ubi ang.
Tara la tunama ka na uro kimanam, turuo kan lalabie o uro kimanam.”
Iesu la tiesong gare tiro, tie, kasupong na kimanam ga origiong kasup ga kimanam ga uabu uriro kimanam na irap a iriro sapsap.

Ga aulo Iesu gare ro, “Nala naviet na kin Siloam.” Origibuong uriro bonim o ties onim lakuan buong gare ro, “Asagameng ga ula.” Tie iriro sapsap la ula ga uviet. Pa tara la ina terigiong, puoong bat meba magimaang maset pagap.

Inamaniap onim na pianam ang ga inamaniap la mime agima tinan, tara la ume maika inamaniap ma kakepup ga pagap meba maialam aun, la megama, “Are mani? Atabo irirot. Migana tinan la ume unama ga ume maika inamaniap ma kakepup?”
Mirie la megama, “Eva, iriet migana.” Pa mirie la megama, “Karuk. Kaunat gare iruo migana, pa irie la non ara.” Pa iriro kan migana la ugama, “Turuot.”
Are ratmat ga amarikmeng, “Are mani ga mumurun irapien nuo?”

Pa upulo ties maiong gare ro, “Iriro migana la meiva Iesu, irie la origiong kimanam ga kasup ga uabu na irapien tuo. Ga toulo, ‘Nala na kin o burunam Siloam ga naviet.’ Are ratmat ga tula ga tuviet ga mumurun irapien tuo ga puorung bat meba maset magimarang pagap.”
Ga amarikmeng, “Iriro migana lagum la unama?” Pa ugama, “Tale arit.”
Tie, alagimeng iriro migana tinan la sapsapong ga mela maiala maun Parasaiop.
Urie, la la okosarong Iesu kimanam ula malusieng ga lemumuriraong irapien a iriro migana na la o sabat.
Are ratmat ga inagat amarikmeng Parasaiop, “Irapien nuo la inagat mumurum gare mani?” Ga maulo gare ro, “Uabu kimanam ula malusieng na irapien tuo ga tuviet ga puorung meba maset magimarang pagap.”

Pa non Parasaiop la megama, “Abit ara, iriro migana la tale kan asagaong Morowa ga muo, memani, tale kan ume ouluan maimai o la o lotu.” Pa mirie la megama, “Are mani migana la amaning kirinim la tale kan puoong meba makosarang non ara kaguma onim na panbinim gare tiro?” Ga nekabatmeng ga betliong narain garipien.
Are ratmat ga amarikmeng iriro migana tinan la sapsapong, “Iriro migana la lemumuriraong irapien nuo, agatnung nuga irie man migana?” Pa upulo iriro migana ties gare ro, “Irie non unuli.”
Migat, tinan iriro migana la sapsapong pa titot la uibat. Pa Iudaiap la tale nameng meba naganmeng ira. Are ratmat ga marikmeng aime mamo ga naga ang iriro migana la uli ra irapien a.
Mulio ga lemarikmeng gare ro, “Atabo iriro la poi meng, a? Ga tara la iaria naga irie la sapsapong ara, tiesmang gare tiro? Pa are mani ga inara ui titot?”
Pa mamo ga naga ang la lipulo ties gare ro, “Ait it, irie poi ing. Pa tara la iaria naga irie la sapsapong ara, are tiro ga ait.
Pa titot la menava irap a gare mani, tale kan ait. Ga aga la unavan irapien a, irie gat la tale ait. Amarikming: Kakani ra. Puoong meba kan mialava.”

Mamo ga naga la tiesliong gare ro. Memani, lirau me Iudaiap la meburio ties gare ro, leba tiesang noba gare ro Iesu irie Karisito irie la eba ina malagiang teip ga magaulap am, tie eba akalameng na luguan o usingnualap.
Irirot i muana ga ties ong mamo ga naga ang iriro migana, ga ligama “Kakani ra. Mumuru le amarikming.”
Tie lama narain tara la inagat amarikmeng iriro migana tinan la sapsapong. Ga amelo gare ro, “Naving bonim a Morowa. Avet it, iriro migana la tiesnung a, irie migana o ukosar o kirinim.”
Ga upulo ties gare ro, “Leba irie ba migana o kirinim o karuk, tale arit. Namurit it paga la arit. Tinan la sapsaptung, pa titot la inara uri.”
Ga inagat amarikmeng gare ro, “Mani la akosarong ira nuo? Unavan irapien nuo gare mani?”
Ga upulo ties maiong gare ro, “Mirulo ra pa tale iga miomira. Memani ga miga miptang tiestung ma papot ma tarap? Atabo mimi gat la miga mimi ba lop am o usingnualap, a?”
Ga fugaumeng ira a ga tiesmeng gare ro, “Nunuot kulot ang iriro migana o usingnualap. Pa pava lop am Moses o usingnualap.
Apet ara, Morowa la ualo ties aun Moses. Pa iriro migana lagum la mavo, tale kan apet.”
Iriro migana la upulam ga ugama, “Iriro paga o turupnuabap, la tale amit onim lagum, pa lekosarong irapien tuo ga ina uri!
Abit ara Morowa la tale kan ume upto ties ang migana la ume okosar kirinim. Pa migana la ume lotu me ai Morowa ga ume ouluan agat ang Morowa, tie Morowa la ume upto ties ang.
Maio tinan ga puoieng titot karuk kan a gas ba a migana ba la sapsapong tara la iaria naga ang, ga tubiat non migana la unavan irapien a.
La tale asagaong Morowa iriro migana ga muong, tie tala kan puoong meba akosarang paga ba.”
Mepulo Iudaiap ties ang, “Naga nung la noiat na tavuk o kirinim, ga nunuo migana o kirinim migat! Pa nuga pasingnala, a?” Ga akalameng na luguan o usingnualap ga ula.
Inamaniap la tale naganmeng kamena gare sapsap
Tie, upto ra Iesu ties a iriro migana la akalameng Iudaiap na luguan o usingnualap, urie teuara ga ula aup iriro migana ga aulo Iesu gare ro, “Nagannung ira Migana migat ang Morowa, o karuk?”
Pa upulo iriro migana gare ro, “Ila Kakani, iriro Poi ang migana irie aga? Tonalava meba nagantang ira!”
Ga aulo Iesu, “Agimanung ara. Irirot i migana la man tiesong ga nunuo titot.”
Ugama iriro migana, “Ila Kakani, nagantung.” Ga lotuong me ai Iesu.
Pa ugama Iesu, “Muruo na uro kimanam meba avuvurarang tavuk maiang teip ga magaulap. Are ratmat ga inamaniap la sapsapmeng, eba ina umeing. Pa inamaniap la mime umai, eba sapsapmeng.”
Non Parasaiop la maionama kagarat ai Iesu, la mepto uriro ties. Are ratmat ga amarikmeng, “Nuga tiesnang gare ratmat pava gat la sapsappang, a?”
Pa maulo Iesu gare ro, “La sapsapmeng irap mi, tie eba tale mimaning kirinim. Pa mime migama, ‘Irap pa la mime umei.’ Are ratmat ga man iot ka kirinim ming.
